title: Age Evidence Basis
description: How an age-composition claim was established. This describes evidence about an audience, not whether the seller can resolve age for an individual impression.

enumDescriptions.verified: Age was established at the user level through an age-assurance or identity-verification method.
enumDescriptions.declared: The user supplied an age, date of birth, or threshold affirmation without independent verification.
enumDescriptions.inferred: Age was predicted for an individual user from behavior, attributes, or another model.
enumDescriptions.population_estimate: Age composition was estimated for an aggregate population, such as from a survey or panel; it says nothing about a particular user.
